title: SheetXL Command Catalog
description: A per-(scope, language) command chrome catalog: <name>.cmd.<tag>.json. The English default is <name>.cmd.en.json; each shipped locale file is a COMPLETE pack.

scope.description: The CommandRegistry scope name these commands OWN (e.g. sheet, workbook, selection, movable, editor, app, scriptEditor).

label.description: Localizable display name for the scope (e.g. the shortcut-keys dialog grouping).

tag.description: BCP-47 language tag; 'en' is the default.

version.description: Envelope format version, for forward-compatible migrations.

groupLabels.description: Per-surface label overrides keyed by groupKey (the label@<groupKey> variants).

shortcut.description: Compact VSCode-style binding string ('ctrl+shift+h'), or an array of alternatives. In a LOCALE catalog, null means explicitly unbound in this locale (absence inherits the English binding).

borrow.description: Other scopes that borrow this command (in addition to the file's owner scope).

params.description: RESERVED: placeholder name -> context accessor path.
